in_sanskrit.name: मिलिन
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who crushes or grinds, as in the mind or thoughts.

in_hindi.name: मिलिन
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is a creditor or a debtor, and one who is engaged in a dispute or an argument.

in_tamil.name: மிலின்
in_tamil.long_meaning: One who gives or offers everything, and one who is generous and selfless.

in_telugu.name: మిళిన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who crushes or destroys all obstacles, and one who is powerful and victorious.

in_marathi.name: Milin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Path of the Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Milin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Milin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'milana', which means 'meeting' or 'union'. In Hindu mythology, Milin is the name of a celestial being who facilitates the union of Shiva and Parvati during their annual reunion, Mahashivratri. This name is bestowed upon a child to symbolize the divine connection and blessings from the gods.
